consumed_proxy_result.implemented_representation: tensor-wide activation scale plus tensor-wide weight scale
consumed_proxy_result.decision: Close only tensor-wide activation scaling. Preserve its timing table as a speed prior, but do not replay it or use it as evidence for the production dynamic-token representation.

source_facts: Fp8LinearMethod selects kFp8DynamicTokenSym when activation_scheme is dynamic and CUTLASS FP8 is supported.
The non-block weight representation is kFp8StaticTensorSym.
CutlassFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel consumes the quantized activation and weight through ops.cutlass_scaled_mm.
causal_mismatch.runner_fact: The consumed runner computed activation amax over the entire [M,K] tensor, yielding one scalar scale instead of one scale per row/token.
causal_mismatch.hypothesis: Production per-token activation scaling removes row-to-row dynamic-range loss and should reduce NRMSE below 0.03 while retaining most of the measured 0.064477 s/request speed envelope.

immutable_science.candidate: Pinned vLLM CutlassFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel with its production dynamic per-token E4M3 activation producer and static per-tensor E4M3 weight representation
immutable_science.baseline: Same-B200 BF16 matmul over identical deterministic BF16 source operands and exact output shapes
immutable_science.activation_scale_shape: [M,1], one FP32 reciprocal scale per token/row
immutable_science.weight_scale_shape: one FP32 reciprocal scale for the exact non-block weight tensor, matching kFp8StaticTensorSym
immutable_science.units: M32 is one concurrent B32 invocation and endpoint-batch contribution must be divided by 32 requests. M3679 is per request unless execution proves otherwise. M384 binds the path and remains uncharged.

requirements: Invoke the installed pinned vLLM dynamic-token activation producer used by CutlassFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel when possible; otherwise reproduce its exact [M,1] FP32 reciprocal scale convention and bind that equivalence before the first scientific row.
Keep the non-block weight representation and scale at kFp8StaticTensorSym granularity; do not introduce per-channel or block-weight scaling.
Use the pinned vLLM CUTLASS scaled-mm consumer and prove the loaded SM100 dispatch; torch._scaled_mm is forbidden.
For all eighteen family/M rows, use identical deterministic BF16 source operands for the BF16 control and dynamic-token E4M3 candidate.

Synchronize and persist a first-call completion marker per arm, then persist finiteness, nonzero, cosine, NRMSE, max absolute error, activation and weight scale shapes, saturation fraction, timing samples, and invocation units.
Carry an expected-row ledger and atomically persist every complete baseline/candidate/oracle row before advancing.
Exclude operand generation, quantization, allocation, JIT, planning, and first calls from 8-warmup/40-sample steady-state timing.
Hash-bind the runner, repair-capable owner, preclaim terminal, pinned image, installed producer/consumer module identities, and scale-contract evidence before detached launch.
A pre-sample producer/API defect is incomplete and must retain a live heartbeating same-claim repair owner while a measured restart plus terminal and safe release fit.

disposition.positive: Persist the contract-complete table and corrected aggregate, then release available for director endpoint-integration selection.
disposition.decision_bearing_negative: Persist the complete table and failed numerical or economic gate, close only the production-granularity dynamic-E4M3 CUTLASS component, and release available.
disposition.incomplete: Retain under a live same-claim repair owner while the measured restart plus terminal and safe release fit.
disposition.unsafe_or_unreachable: Release maintenance with the typed guest diagnostic.
